premises.text: African commodity logistics lack flexibility and centralized coordination, so goods cost far more and trucks sit idle most of the time
Lorry is a tech-enabled logistics optimization solution providing flexibility and centralized coordination across the entire journey
premises.evidence_span: We are a tech-enabled logistics optimization solution that provides this flexibility and centralized coordination

premises.text: Thousands of journey data points enable data-driven redirects, decision-making, and live visibility for cargo owners and transporters
premises.evidence_span: by collecting thousands of data points of every single truck in every journey and then providing data-driven decision making through our systems

premises.text: Near-term focus is bulk commodities (grains, fertilizers, cement, sugar) moving large volumes across Sub-Saharan Africa starting in Kenya and Uganda
premises.evidence_span: Right now we're focused on grains, fertilizers, cement, and sugar

value.text: Bring down the cost of goods by revolutionizing logistics across Africa
value.evidence_span: bringing down the cost of goods for all of us and for the whole continent

secondary_value.text: Give cargo owners and transporters peace of mind with journey visibility
secondary_value.evidence_span: allowing them to have peace of mind, which we found to be quite important in these stressful times

causal_links.evidence_span: If the costs were at parity with the United States, you'd be paying up to one-third of the price
Lorry is moving large volumes across Sub-Saharan Africa
